subject.title: feat(onboard): streamline setup with agent-assisted configuration

question: Should this PR fail closed on official ClawHub provenance for legacy or bare install records while adding trusted channel docs metadata, or should it preserve an upgrade/repair path for older records before merge?
rationale: The implementation is focused, but deciding whether older ClawHub records should lose official treatment is a compatibility and plugin-trust policy choice automation should not make.

options.title: Accept fail-closed provenance
options.body: Land the branch if maintainers want official plugin treatment to require explicit official ClawHub URL/channel provenance, accepting that older bare records may need reinstall or repair.

options.title: Add legacy repair first
options.body: Require a doctor or update repair path that upgrades older official ClawHub records before tightening official sync, drift, and update behavior.

options.title: Split trust hardening
options.body: Land the channel JSON metadata separately and move the official ClawHub provenance policy into a smaller security/compatibility PR.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed provenance
recommendation.body: Land the branch if maintainers want official plugin treatment to require explicit official ClawHub URL/channel provenance, accepting that older bare records may need reinstall or repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history across channel command behavior, plugin metadata helpers, and the adjacent onboarding product direction.
